jobs.title: Senior Auditor Quality - OPSP
jobs.excerpt: OverviewThe Sr.  Auditor, Quality Assurance position is responsible for ensuring that the audited claims meet quality standards necessary to generate high quality recoverable claims for the benefit of Cotiviti and our clients.
jobs.description:
Overview

The Sr. Auditor, Quality Assurance position is responsible for ensuring that the audited claims meet quality standards necessary to generate high quality recoverable claims for the benefit of Cotiviti and our clients. Audited claim types include: Outpatient and Specialty Review Types to include SNF, IRF, HH, DME, Hospice and medical necessity. Quality assurance emphasizes compliance with established procedures, accuracy of claim identification and supportive documentation. Identifies and notifies management of observed quality and communicates opportunities for process improvements based on independent audit claims review. Displays professional skepticism that enhances the work performed in order to achieve success in position.

Responsibilities

  • Performs clinical quality assurance review of daily clinical validation reviews. The quality auditor will be responsible for communicating with the initial auditor when there are differing decisions on the audit to ensure that the final decision is supported and as accurate as possible.
  • Integrates healthcare auditing principles and uses objectivity in performance of medical audit activities and review.
  • Utilizes industry knowledge and proficiency in healthcare to substantiate decisions.
  • Performs work independently and reviews work of others.
  • Depending on nature and scope of audit, may review medical records and apply in-depth knowledge of clinical criteria to determine medical necessity, appropriateness of setting, potential billing/coding issues, and quality concerns.
  • May serve as a mentor to other QA auditors or initial auditors.
  • Depending on the business needs, may also flex into the initial audit role and/or the appeals role as needed.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

  • Education
    • Associates or Bachelor's degree in Nursing (active/unrestricted license).
    • Equivalent experience of 5+ years experience in claims auditing, quality assurance, or recovery auditing...ideally in a Clinical Validation Audit setting or a hospital environment.
  • Coding Certification (at least one of the following are required and are to be maintained as a condition of employment).
    • RHIA or RHIT.
    • Inpatient Coding Credential - CCS or CIC preferred.
    • Candidates who hold a CCDS or CPC will be given consideration but will need to obtain an inpatient coding certification within 1 year of their hire date with the company.
  • 3-5 years of healthcare auditing or related experience.
  • Ability to mentor staff and enhance performance as it relates to the quality and productivity of auditors.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work well in an individual and team environment.
  • Computer proficiency in Microsoft office suite required (Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, SharePoint, etc.).

Mental Requirements:

  • Communicating with others to exchange information.
  • Assessing the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of the work assigned.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:

  • Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
  • Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
  • Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
  • Must be able to provide high-speed internet access/connectivity and office setup and maintenance.

Base compensation ranges from $47.00 to $56.00 per hour. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. This role is eligible for discretionary bonus consideration.

Nonexempt employees are eligible to receive overtime pay for hours worked in excess of 40 hours in a given week, or as otherwise required by applicable state law.

Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.

Date of posting: 8/5/2026

Applications are assessed on a rolling basis. We anticipate that the application window will close on 10/5/2026, but the application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

jobs.description:
Position Overview

Qualus is a leading provider of specialized engineering and technical field services. By combining Power Grid Engineering and CE Power Engineered Services, we have over 2000 employees and more than 20 offices throughout the U.S. We offer competitive benefits as well as in-house career and professional skills development through QualU, while providing job opportunities in power systems engineering, field services, and turnkey project management.  

 

Power your future with Qualus as a Account Executive. The Account Executive is responsible for maintaining and expanding relationships with our strategically important Clients. Assigned to one or more Clients, the Account Executive is responsible for developing winning strategies for opportunities, pipeline management, relationship management, strategic account planning, market intelligence and supports the Qualus engineering / field service offices assigned to that key account. The Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for each AE will be driven by Client satisfaction as measured by order intake / meeting revenue goals, repeat business, and Tier Level progression. The AE represents the entire range of services Qualus offers to a specific account and makes recommendations on new services tightly coupled with our core competences / focus. The AE will lead the account planning cycle and ensure their needs and expectations are met by the company. Apply now and join the Qualus team! 

Responsibilities

  • Plans, facilitates, and conducts meaningful customer engagements with support from engineering offices / service line leads.

  • Acts as focal point for problem resolution and monitors the successful close out of issues and actions. Able to build lasting, trusting, and widespread relationships across the customer’s organization.

  • Participates with Qualus management to develop and execute Key Account Plans.

  • Delivers new insights and connects experts to the customer while respectfully challenging the status quo.

  • Actively engages in critical project touch points, anticipates the need for intervention and escalation and takes action to initiate such communication.

  • Ownership of sales targets, account coverage and customer satisfaction targets for the account.

  • Takes accountability for the monthly, quarterly, and annual results on the overall account.

  • Promotes Master Service Agreements with customers to simplify the business process.

  • Represents and promotes all services lines across the business.

  • Develops and maintains detailed understanding of the customer’s business strategy, purchasing behavior, organizational structure including, customer needs, regulatory drivers, threats, economic trends, and competition.

  • Provides insight to customers by providing knowledge to guide customers as they navigate alternatives.

  • Monitors competitors’ activity with each potential and existing account and ensures that appropriate response strategies are formulated and implemented. Including but not limited to technical and commercial feedback in accordance with Qualus ethics and process guidelines.

  • Leads the development and implementation of the overall Key Account Plan for assigned accounts or products lines, executive relationship strategy and coverage plans, identifying and prioritizing sales opportunities, and implementing recovery plans in the case of off target performance.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering preferred, however a Bachelor’s degree with demonstrated and relevant utility experience is acceptable.

  • Five (5) or more years of power systems experience

  • Experience with electric utilities, high voltage substations and / or major substation equipment.

  • Individual must be proficient in Microsoft Office products to include Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Visio. Microsoft Project is a plus.

  • Successfully manages proposal process on all assigned inquires and develops external and internal customer relationships through consistent follow-up and communication.

  • Contributes to improve sales and customer satisfaction by promptly, accurately and appropriately responding to sales inquiries and addressing customer concerns/issues and corrective/preventive actions.

Benefits & Compensation

Qualus benefits offered include Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short and Long-Term Disability, 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, EAP, Parental Leave, Paid time off, and Holidays, for those who qualify.

The final salary awarded for this role may vary from the above range based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs. The salary range provided in this job posting may be subject to change for business purposes.

Company Overview

Qualus is a leading pure-play power solutions firm and innovator at the forefront of power infrastructure transformation, with differentiated capabilities across grid modernization, resiliency, security, and sustainability. The firm partners with utilities, commercial, industrial, data center, and government clients, and renewable and energy storage developers, offering comprehensive solutions through boutique and integrated advisory, planning, engineering, digital solutions, program management, energy efficiency and specialized field services. Qualus also provides software and technology enabled services and develops breakthrough solutions for critical power industry challenges such as distributed and variable resource integration, emergency management, and secure data exchange. The firm has over 2,000 professionals, with offices throughout the U.S. and Canada.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We are committed to providing an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on any grounds protected by applicable human rights legislation across Canada and the US.

We are committed to a secure and transparent hiring process. We do not request payment or sensitive personal information, such as Social Security numbers or banking details, during the application process. Please use caution and verify opportunities through our official channels.

  • Strong technical foundation, with the ability to quickly understand a product that works across the stack and speak to technical buyers

jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityWe’re looking for a seasoned Security Engineer who has started applying that expertise to AI/ML systems.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

We’re looking for a seasoned Security Engineer who has started applying that expertise to AI/ML systems. This role is a natural next step for someone who knows the security fundamentals inside and out and is now getting hands-on with the unique threat landscape that comes with AI — prompt injection, model integrity, agentic pipelines, and the rest. You don’t need to have spent years in a dedicated AI security role; what matters is that you’ve got the security depth and the curiosity to learn fast in a space that’s evolving quickly.

Working under the Director of Security Engineering & Operations, you’ll drive security implementation, automation, and compliance across our AI/ML development lifecycle — collaborating closely with Architecture, Product Development, Platform, DevOps, and IT.

What You’ll Do

  • Assess and mitigate security risks specific to AI/ML systems — including model integrity, data poisoning, prompt injection, adversarial attacks, and agentic AI threat vectors
  • Implement and maintain security processes, tooling, and automation across AI/ML pipelines and infrastructure
  • Define and enforce secure AI development and delivery practices across the SDLC
  • Evaluate and help secure agentic AI systems, including multi-agent architectures, tool-use frameworks, and autonomous decision-making pipelines
  • Contribute to AI governance initiatives, including policy development, risk assessments, and responsible AI frameworks aligned with regulatory and industry standards
  • Partner cross-functionally to embed AI security controls across engineering and operations teams
  • Own AI security projects end-to-end, from conception through delivery
  • Develop and maintain technical security documentation for AI systems and models
  • Support compliance initiatives, audits, and technical assessments relevant to AI/ML environments

What You’ll Bring

Required

  • Minimum 7-10 years of experience in a hands-on security architecture and engineering role in an agile SaaS development organization
  • Proven success driving cross-functional security initiatives in an agile SaaS development organization
  • Solid foundation and experience in AppSec core domains
  • Direct, hands-on, end to end, experience with the following
    • Security architecture and implementation in context of microservice, cloud-native, and serverless application architectures
    • GitOps implementation, security, and utilization
    • Security tooling and automation development, as software
    • Continuous security and compliance
  • Recent hands-on exposure to securing AI/ML environments
  • Working familiarity with AI/ML security risks and frameworks — OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act. You don’t need to have lived in these for years; you need to understand what they’re solving for
  • Awareness of agentic AI architectures and the risks that come with them — autonomous agents, tool orchestration, memory systems, multi-agent coordination

Preferred

We know AI security is a new discipline. These aren’t screens — they’re signals of someone who’s been leaning into this space.

  • Direct experience with LLM security, model red-teaming, or AI threat modeling
  • Hands-on work securing agentic AI systems (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar frameworks)
  • Experience contributing to or implementing AI governance programs, risk registers, or responsible AI policies
  • Experience with security incident response in AI/ML environments
  • with AI/ML workloads
  • Familiarity with AI governance principles: model transparency, explainability, bias/fairness considerations, and data lineage
  • Relevant certifications, e.g. ISC2 (AI Security, CISSP, CCSP, CSSLP, ISSAP, ISSEP)

Location:

This position will be remote with preference given to EST time zone.

AI Mindset at Euna Solutions

We believe the future of work is human + AI. At Euna Solutions, we encourage our team members to leverage AI tools to enhance creativity, efficiency, and decision-making. We’re looking for people who are curious about emerging technologies, eager to experiment, and committed to using AI responsibly to augment—not replace—their expertise.

If you enjoy exploring new ways to solve problems, learning continuously, and applying AI to make your work smarter and more impactful, you’ll thrive here.

What It's Like to Work at Euna Solutions

At Euna Solutions, we carefully foster a work environment where employees have a safe space for creative and intellectual freedom, and the opportunity to work cross-functionally. We offer a dynamic environment with considerable opportunities for professional growth and advancement. 

Here are some of the perks that Euna employees enjoy:

CIEE is a non-profit study abroad and intercultural exchange organization that transforms lives and builds bridges between individuals and nations through study abroad and international exchange experiences that help people develop skills for living in a globally interdependent and multi-cultural world.

Why work with us:

  • You will change the world. CIEE builds bridges between people, countries, and cultures. We help young people participate in high-quality international exchange and study abroad programs that bring the world together. We change lives; our alumni change the world. Be part of the change!

jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation

Up to $50/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~20 hours each; you set your own schedule.

Quartile, the world's largest retail media optimization platform, is a trusted partner for multichannel e-commerce success. Through unmatched expertise and patented AI technology, we fuel growth for 5,300+ brands and sellers worldwide and manage an annual ad spend exceeding $2 billion. The award-winning platform covers major marketplaces and ad channels for optimal reach. The result is unprecedented granularity, smarter budgeting, and bespoke solutions for retailers.

Quartile is proud to be an equal opportunity employer with employees stemming from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences. As a business, we value the enrichment that diversity brings to our organization and are committed to a culture that creates a sense of inclusion and belonging. We welcome new perspectives and affirm that all employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, age, familial or marital status, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law.

OVERVIEW:
We are looking for a strategic, hands-on Director of Enablement to build and scale the programs that make our revenue teams exceptional. Sitting at the intersection of Marketing, SDR, Sales and Customer Growth (expansion sales) you'll own the enablement function end-to-end — from onboarding new SDRs to leveling up our Customer Growth Managers (CGMs) with the skills, content, and tools they need to hit and exceed their goals.

This isn't a 'build decks and run trainings' role. It's a strategic seat at the table — you'll shape how we go to market, how we upsell customers, and how we build a team culture where reps love to learn.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 6+ years in Revenue Enablement, Sales Enablement, or a related GTM function — ideally spanning SDR, AE, or CS teams.
  • Proven track record building or significantly scaling enablement programs from the ground up.
  • Deep understanding of B2B SaaS GTM motions — pipeline generation, expansion revenue, and churn reduction.
  • Understanding of how to leverage AI to create enablement programs that scale.
  • Strong instructional design skills — you know how adults learn and build content that sticks.
  • Data-first mindset — you define success metrics before launching programs, not after.
  • Experience with modern enablement tools (Gong, Salesloft, or similar).
  • Experience with Salesforce.
  • Excellent cross-functional influencer — you build trust with Sales, CS and product marketing.
  • Player-coach mentality: you can set the strategy and still run the workshop yourself.

….. If you reached this point, we hope you're feeling excited about the job description. We're eager to meet people that believe in Quartile's mission and can contribute to our team in a variety of ways. Feel welcome to apply!

BONUS:

  • Experience specifically enabling CGM or expansion-focused revenue teams
  • Background in Customer Success or post-sale motions
  • Familiarity with SPIN, MEDDIC, SPICED, or similar sales methodologies
  • Experience hiring and managing a small enablement team
  • Startup experience — you know how to build fast with limited resources

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

As Director of Enablement, you will:

  • Define and execute an enablement strategy aligned to revenue goals across SDR, sales & CGM teams
  • Build scalable onboarding programs that reduce time-to-productivity across all three teams
  • Design continuous learning pathways — certifications, playbooks, and skill assessments — that grow with each function
  • Equip SDRs with prospecting frameworks, outreach sequences, and objection-handling playbooks that fill the pipeline.
  • Build the commercial playbook for CGMs covering upsell, cross-sell, expansion motions, and deal coaching.
  • Design CSM enablement for onboarding delivery, risk identification, QBR execution, and renewal motions.
  • Own the enablement tech stack and ensure strong adoption across all teams.
  • Partner with Product Marketing to keep messaging, battle cards, and competitive intel sharp and current.
  • Build and maintain a centralized content library that reps actually use.
  • Define OKRs and leading indicators for each enablement program and report regularly to Revenue leadership on ROI.

BENEFITS:

Comprehensive Insurance Coverage

401K Plan with Employer Match

Generous Paid Time Off (24 Vacation days, 7 Sick days, 12 Company Holidays, Short Summer Fridays)

Company Laptop + additional tech accessories

The base pay for this position is targeted at $130,000 - $150,000 per year with bonus based on performance.

Position Summary
The Manager Training & QA role is accountable for leading the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of training, learning development, and quality assurance programs that support Customer Care Center operations. This position develops and leads a high-performing team of training and quality professionals responsible for new hire onboarding, ongoing skill development, performance support, quality monitoring, calibration, coaching effectiveness, compliance readiness, and customer experience improvement. The role ensures training curricula, quality standards, scorecards, learning evaluations, and feedback processes are aligned with business objectives, regulatory requirements, customer experience expectations, and contact center performance goals. This leader uses operational data, quality results, customer feedback, speech and interaction analytics, and industry best practices to identify performance gaps, recommend solutions, and drive measurable improvements in agent capability, service consistency, first contact resolution, customer satisfaction, and operational effectiveness.


Key Responsibilities
Oversees the development, maintenance, implementation, performance measurement, and resource planning of all Customer Care Center Training and Quality Assurance programs.

  • Leads the strategy, execution, performance measurement, and resource planning for Customer Care Center training, learning development, knowledge management, and quality assurance programs.
  • Supervises, coaches, develops, and holds accountable training and quality assurance personnel, including assessment of role effectiveness, leadership capability, coaching quality, calibration consistency, and achievement of individual and team performance objectives.
  • Builds and maintains development plans, performance goals, succession plans, feedback routines, and accountability practices that support employee growth, leadership continuity, and department performance.
  • Provides guidance on employee performance, behavior, attendance, professionalism, quality trends, and fact-finding activities identified through training, coaching, and quality monitoring processes.
  • Ensures compliance with internal policies, external quality standards, regulatory requirements, customer privacy expectations, documentation standards, applicable bargaining unit requirements, and compliance readiness expectations.
  • Leads training needs analysis, curriculum design, facilitation planning, delivery method selection, learning evaluation, knowledge transfer, job aid development, and ongoing maintenance of new hire, cross-training, refresher, upskilling, nesting, and train-the-trainer programs.
  • Establishes and maintains quality assurance standards, behavior-based scorecards, monitoring guidelines, sampling strategies, calibration routines, dispute resolution processes, and quality reporting practices across applicable work streams and customer contact channels.
  • Oversees quality assessments for calls, digital contacts, back-office work, case processing, and other customer interactions to ensure consistency, accuracy, empathy, compliance, and effective issue resolution.
  • Partners with Operations and cross-functional leaders to translate training outcomes, quality results, customer feedback, escalation trends, and performance data into coaching priorities, process improvements, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Uses call data, quality results, speech and interaction analytics, customer feedback, knowledge trends, and operational metrics to identify trends, root causes, performance gaps, and improvement opportunities that strengthen customer satisfaction, first contact resolution, accuracy, compliance, and agent performance.
  • Defines, deploys, and governs continuous improvement processes for training, quality monitoring, coaching, knowledge transfer, compliance readiness, corrective and preventive action, business continuity, and validation of improvement effectiveness.
  • Serves as a primary point of contact and subject matter expert for training, quality, knowledge management, learning management, workforce optimization, speech analytics, technology partners, vendor solutions, application upgrades, remote onboarding readiness, and other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Business, Education, Organizational Development, Communications, or related field, or comparable industry-related work experience.

  • 4-6 years of leadership experience in Customer Service, Contact Center Operations, Training, Quality Assurance, or a related customer experience environment required.
  • Experience leading training, quality, coaching, performance management, and development programs for customer service employees and management personnel.
  • Experience designing or managing adult learning programs, new hire onboarding, refresher training, knowledge transfer, and learning effectiveness measurement.
  • Experience managing quality monitoring programs, behavior-based scorecards, calibration sessions, quality reporting, agent feedback processes, and performance improvement plans.
  • Occasional to moderate travel required.
  • Demonstrates excellent computer skills, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, learning management systems, quality monitoring tools, reporting platforms, and other contact center technology.
  • Knowledge of contact center operations and technology, including call drivers, digital contact channels, performance metrics, progressive targets, statistical analysis, workforce optimization tools, knowledge management, and center-specific systems/applications.
  • Working knowledge of Field Operations, Billing, Revenue Recovery, regulatory, and customer account processes that impact customer care interactions.
  • Knowledge of local, regional, and industry regulatory rules and requirements affecting customer service, documentation, privacy, compliance, and quality assurance.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and manage relationships at all levels, including Operations, Human Resources, Labor Relations, Compliance, Technology, and external partners.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to build strong, collaborative partnerships and influence outcomes across functional areas.
  • Proven ability to influence change, build consensus, and lead continuous improvement across a large or matrixed organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive excellence in customer experience, service quality, compliance, first contact resolution, and operational performance within a customer care facility.
  • Established track record of organizational agility, managerial courage, sound judgment, and effective decision-making in a dynamic operational environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to focus on employee engagement, coaching effectiveness, development, and accountability while maintaining operational performance expectations.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple activities and complex projects simultaneously; ability to establish and meet critical deadlines.
  • Superior problem resolution skills, root cause analysis capability, and strong analytical skills.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills, excellent business writing skills, and a proven track record in meeting or exceeding stated deadlines and milestones.
  • Aptitude for detail, high degree of organization, and ability to maintain accurate training, quality, compliance, and performance documentation.
  • Proficiency and comfort with leading, coaching, communicating with, and maintaining reporting relationships across remote, hybrid, and onsite work environments.
  • Ability to lead and motivate a dispersed workforce, including onsite and remote employees.

Preferred Qualifications
4-6 years’ experience in training and/or quality assurance leadership at a customer care facility or contact center.

  • Experience with speech analytics, interaction analytics, quality management, workforce optimization, learning management, or knowledge management tools.
  • Six Sigma, Lean, process improvement, root cause analysis, or continuous improvement certification or experience.
  • Certification or formal training in instructional design, training facilitation, adult learning, coaching, customer experience, quality assurance, or contact center management.
  • Experience supporting omnichannel customer interactions, including phone, chat, email, digital, back-office, or case management work streams.

jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation

Up to $40/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~20 hours each; you set your own schedule.

jobs.description:
Intellect builds mental health technology used by employers across Asia Pacific and beyond. Our psychosocial risk assessment (PRA) tells enterprise clients where the risks to psychological health sit in their organisation, and what to do about them.

This role owns the research behind our PRA methodology. You will validate and adapt the instruments behind our psychosocial risk and clinical outcomes reporting, build the benchmarks that make client results interpretable, and be the person who can say clearly what our data supports and what it does not. You will also work closely with stakeholders of academic institutions and client organisations to further validate our framework, and publish case studies.

This role suits someone genuinely hands-on with data, comfortable in front of an enterprise client, and drawn to the applied end of measurement science rather than publication for its own sake.

Measurement and validation

  • Own psychometric validation of Intellect’s psychosocial risk instrument and adaptation for new markets and regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain the analysis logic behind psychosocial risk reporting, and be able to reproduce and explain outputs independently of the automation pipeline.
  • Own the definitions for clinical outcome metrics used in product and client reporting.

Benchmarking and data integrity

  • Build and maintain benchmarks and norms for our assessment framework
  • Manage survey panel and data collection partners for benchmark development.

Analysis and innovation

  • Design and run evaluation of AI-enabled features.
  • Bring new analytical approaches into the clinical function

Client and partner work

  • Present findings to enterprise clients, HR and risk leaders, and government stakeholders.
  • Support case study development and evidence assets for commercial teams.
  • Work with academic partners on collaborative studies.

Requirements

  • Postgraduate degree in psychology, organisational psychology, statistics or biostatistics, economics, epidemiology or public health, data science, or another quantitative social science.
  • At least 3 years of applied research experience, ideally including outside a purely academic setting.
  • Strong proficiency in statistical analysis and using statistical programs
  • Survey design experience, including adapting measures across populations or markets.
  • A track record of presenting analytical findings to senior non-technical audiences.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Desirable

  • Psychosocial risk, ISO 45003, workplace mental health or occupational health experience.
  • Experience training or enabling non-specialist colleagues.
  • Familiarity with regulatory requirements for workplace psychological health in Australia, Singapore, and Asia.

Benefits

Why You’ll Love Working With Us:

  • Global company – work in a diverse environment with people from nearly 20 countries
  • Generous leave policy – time off to rest and recharge
  • Christmas week off – company-wide break during Christmas, separate from annual leave
  • Birthday leave – enjoy a day off on your birthday
  • Quarterly mental health days – one day off every quarter to focus on your wellbeing
  • Flexible work arrangements – work in a way that suits your lifestyle and goals
  • Work-life balance – a culture that values personal time and long-term wellness
  • Medical coverage – comprehensive insurance for peace of mind
  • Performance bonus – high performance is recognised and rewarded
  • Development budget - annual allowance to support your professional development
  • Mental health support – premium coaching access to our mental health app and resources & dedicated budget for clinical and psychiatric care
  • Socialsand communities – regular non-work events/activities to connect and have fun together

jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

About the Role

You’ll design coding tasks that challenge frontier AI coding agents. Each task is a self-contained Docker environment with a broken piece of software; an AI agent attempts the fix; automated tests verify the outcome. Your deliverable is the full task package: broken code, tests, instructions, and a reference solution proving the task is solvable.

Responsibilities:

  • Invent a realistic developer scenario — a real bug, a broken ETL, a missing feature — not a toy problem.
  • Build a reproducible Docker environment with pinned dependencies.
  • Write a pytest that verifies outcomes, not specific commands — deterministic, non-flaky, and does not leak the fix.
  • Write an instruction.md that reads like a Jira ticket a developer would receive.
  • Write a reference solve.sh proving the task is solvable.
  • Calibrate difficulty so current state-of-the-art agents solve the task 20–60% of the time.
  • Iterate based on feedback from expert QA reviewers.
  • Later: review other authors’ tasks as a QA reviewer.

Not in scope

  • Data labeling, prompt engineering.
  • Production code to ship — you design problems and verification for AI agents.
  • Leetcode puzzles — scenarios must look like real developer work.
  • Not every candidate task ships — quality over quantity.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of production software development in one backend stack — Python, Go, Node.js, Java, or Rust. Depth in one stack beats breadth.
  • Python + pytest fluency — required regardless of primary stack. The task harness is pytest-based even when the broken app is in another language. Fixtures, parametrize, monkeypatch, timeouts, conftest.py.
  • Docker authoring — reproducible Dockerfiles, pinned dependencies, multi-stage builds when needed, non-root user.
  • Linux & Bash — comfort debugging inside containers (strace, lsof, journalctl); shell beyond set -euo pipefail.
  • AI coding agent experience — Claude Code, Cursor, Roo Code, or similar, on non-trivial work. You can cite a specific time the AI was confidently wrong and how you caught it.
  • English — B2+ written.

Not a fit

  • Data Science, ML, or Computer Vision engineers without backend-engineering output.
  • Manual QA testers without automation or test authoring.
  • Frontend-only, low-code / no-code, IT Support, or Business Analysts.
  • Engineers who have never written pytest from scratch.
  • Junior, intern, or assistant as the most recent role.

Preferred qualifications

  • Domain depth in Security, System Administration (nginx / systemd / cron), Scientific Computing (NumPy / PyTorch / SciPy), DevOps, or Git internals.
  • Modern Python tooling (uv, poetry, pyproject.toml).
  • Coverage tooling (pytest-cov, coverage.py, gcov, llvm-cov, kcov).
  • Fuzzing or property-based testing (Hypothesis).
  • Prior contribution to agent-evaluation benchmarks or related frameworks.

Process

Apply → Pass qualification (90-minute sample-task screen + short behavioral interview) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid.

Time commitment

  • Onboarding: ~10 hours per first task.
  • Steady state: ~5 hours per task, 2–4 parallel tasks per author.
  • Realistic weekly load: 8–20 hours. Higher volume available for top performers.
  • You choose when and how to contribute; tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet acceptance criteria.

Compensation:

  • Paid contributions, rates up to $35/hour*.
  • Task-based compensation equivalent to hourly rate, depending on performance and volume.
  • Some projects include incentive payments.

*Rates vary based on expertise, skills assessment, location, project needs, and other factors. Higher rates may be provided to highly specialized experts. Lower rates may apply during onboarding or non-core project phases. Payment details are shared per project.

Apply

Submit your CV via the Mindrift platform. Indicate your English level, note this role (Software Engineering Evaluation Specialist — Terminal Bench), and include a GitHub profile link if available.

jobs.excerpt: Bamboo Health is the leader in Real-Time Care Intelligence™ solutions aimed at improving lives for everyone experiencing physical and behavioral health challenges.
jobs.description:
Bamboo Health is the leader in Real-Time Care Intelligence™ solutions aimed at improving lives for everyone experiencing physical and behavioral health challenges. We are driven by our mission to empower clients to deliver seamless, high-quality and cost-effective care during pivotal moments to improve health outcomes. From coast to coast, Bamboo Health partners with all major retail pharmacy chains, 52 states and territories, 100% of the top 10 best hospitals and more than half of the country’s largest health plans to improve more than 1 billion patient encounters annually. Join us in improving lives during pivotal care moments!

Summary:

We are seeking a highly analytical and customer-focused Product Manager to join our Controlled Substances Reporting team. This role is ideal for a data-focused Product Manager with a strong product foundation who is ready to go deep — building rare, hard-to-develop expertise in one of healthcare's most complex and highly regulated domains, where data quality, regulatory nuance, and customer trust are everything.

As a Product Manager, you will establish yourself as the subject matter expert in Controlled Substance data and reporting solutions, partnering with customers, engineering, analytics, and product leadership to develop products that deliver meaningful value to healthcare organizations, pharmacies, government agencies, and other stakeholders.

Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, proficiency in SQL and Tableau, and the ability to translate complex customer, business, and regulatory requirements into scalable product solutions.

Active, fluent use of AI-supported tools is essential to operating effectively at this scale. The ideal candidate is naturally curious, comfortable working with large and complex datasets, and excited to use data-driven insights to influence product decisions.

What You’ll Do:

  • Serve as the subject matter expert for Bamboo Health's Controlled Substance products, data assets, reporting capabilities, customer use cases, and regulatory landscape.
  • Use SQL, Tableau, and other analytical tools to identify customer needs, investigate data questions, validate assumptions, and support product decision-making.
  • Own the discovery, prioritization, definition, and delivery of Controlled Substances reporting and data product initiatives from problem identification through customer adoption.
  • Help define the strategy for Controlled Substances data products, including how reporting, analytics, governance, metadata, and AI-enabled capabilities can support customer value, scalability, and revenue growth.
  • Partner with customer-facing teams to manage customer expectations, clarify scope, communicate tradeoffs, and distinguish between defects, MVP gaps, enhancements, and requests that are not technically feasible or strategically aligned.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to improve data governance, reduce customer friction, and recommend scalable solutions.
  • Support the development of AI-enabled analytics capabilities by defining use cases, data requirements, governance needs, and success metrics.
  • Translate customer feedback, market needs, business requirements, and data insights into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success measures.
  • Support user acceptance testing (UAT) and ensure delivered solutions meet customer and business expectations.
  • Evaluate competing customer, regulatory, technical, support, and revenue priorities to recommend roadmap tradeoffs and protect delivery focus.
  • Create and maintain product documentation, including user guides, workflows, and data definitions.

What Success Looks Like…

In 3 months…

  • Develop a strong understanding of Bamboo Health's Controlled Substance products, customers, regulatory environment, and key datasets.
  • Independently use SQL and Tableau to answer customer and business questions and contribute product insights.
  • Build relationships with customers and stakeholders while contributing requirements and recommendations informed by data and feedback.
  • Begin leveraging AI-supported tools to improve research, documentation, and product execution.

In 6 months…

  • Become a trusted resource for Controlled Substance reporting, data, and customer workflows.
  • Independently lead discovery, customer conversations, and requirements gathering for product enhancements.
  • Proactively identify product opportunities using customer feedback, data analysis, and market insights.
  • Consistently deliver high-quality requirements, documentation, and recommendations while maintaining an effective AI-enabled workflow.

In 12 months…

  • Be recognized as a subject matter expert in Controlled Substance reporting, data, customer workflows, and regulatory requirements.
  • Independently lead complex product initiatives from discovery through delivery, partnering effectively across customers, engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders.
  • Consistently deliver high-quality requirements, documentation, and product recommendations that drive customer and business outcomes.
  • Proactively identify data quality issues, customer pain points, and product opportunities, making well-reasoned recommendations and driving solutions forward.
  • Leverage AI-supported tools and automation to improve the quality, efficiency, and scalability of your product work.

What You Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, Healthcare Administration, Public Health, or a related field; or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in product management, product analytics, data analysis, or a related discipline, with demonstrated progression in scope and ownership.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, including the ability to independently query and analyze large, complex datasets.
  • Proficiency with Tableau, including dashboard development, data visualization, and analytical storytelling.
  • Experience translating business needs and data insights into product recommendations, requirements, and technical solutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with sound judgment and creativity in designing solutions.
  • Experience working in a highly regulated industry such as healthcare, government, insurance, or financial services.
  • Experience working with healthcare, pharmacy, public health, claims, or controlled substance data.
  • Experience working with data governance frameworks, metadata management, data quality programs, reporting standards, or enterprise analytics initiatives.
  • Familiarity with Agile product development methodologies and tools such as Jira and Confluence.
  • Experience supporting product discovery, roadmap planning, product delivery, or customer-facing product initiatives.
  • Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards, healthcare regulations, or state government technology programs.
  • Experience using Python or other analytical tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to rapidly master a complex, highly regulated domain and establish credibility as a subject matter expert with customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Active, demonstrated use of AI-supported tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or similar) to meaningfully accelerate product work — including research, drafting, analysis, and documentation.
  • Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced, high-growth, and rapidly evolving environments.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote-first environment, ensuring high-quality virtual interactions with minimal distractions.
  • The ability to travel periodically for work.

What You Get:

  • Join one of the most innovative healthcare technology companies in the country.
  • Have the autonomy to build something with an enthusiastically supportive team.
  • Build deep, rare expertise in a specialized and high-impact domain — controlled substance data that touches pharmacies, government agencies, and health systems across the country.
  • Receive competitive compensation including health, dental, vision and other benefits.

Belonging at Bamboo

We Care. #BambooHealthValuesCare

Every human being has the right to the best possible healthcare. Our Real-Time Care Intelligence™ solutions enable healthcare professionals to see and treat every individual as a whole person by providing the right information, at the right time – regardless of physical, behavioral or social barriers.

We’re a great place to work because we care. We continually seek to learn about our differences and ensure the unique perspectives and contributions of all employees are welcome, valued and celebrated.

Our commitment to making a positive impact starts by recognizing and leveraging our differences, building inclusive teams and cultivating a sense of belonging.

jobs.excerpt: About BR-DGEBR-DGE is an award-winning FinTech founded in Edinburgh, powered by a high-performing, remote-first team across the UK and beyond.
jobs.description:
About BR-DGE

BR-DGE is an award-winning FinTech founded in Edinburgh, powered by a high-performing, remote-first team across the UK and beyond. Our platform gives e-commerce and technology businesses the freedom and flexibility to redefine how they handle payments.

Since 2018, we've been pioneers in payment orchestration, enabling enterprise brands to optimise their infrastructure and create frictionless digital experiences. From travel giants to household retail names, our global customer base is growing fast, supported by world-class partners like Visa and Worldpay.

The journey so far has been incredible, but we're just getting started. We are looking for exceptional talent to join us as we level up our engineering maturity.

About this role

This is a software engineering role, not a QA or manual testing role. At BR-DGE, our Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) is a core engineer who architects, builds, and scales our automated testing infrastructure and quality tooling in Java. You will write production-grade code that enables our teams to ship high quality software frequently and with total confidence - not execute test cases.

You will not sit at the end of a delivery pipeline manually validating tickets or acting as a gatekeeper. You will not be running scripted or exploratory manual tests. Instead, you own the technical design, development, and evolution of our centralised automation frameworks and infrastructure, engineering systemic solutions that let development teams own their own quality and deploy safely.

Who this isn't for: if your background is primarily manual QA, exploratory testing, or test-case execution, even with some scripting exposure, this role isn't the right fit. We need someone who identifies as, and has worked as, a software engineer first.

What you'll be doing

  • Framework Architecture and Engineering: Design and build automation frameworks in Java, covering Integration, Contract, E2E, and Performance / Load testing. Be informed and opinionated on what good looks like for Unit and Component tests.
  • Tooling and Infrastructure Development: Build, maintain, and scale internal testing tools, libraries, and test data management utilities that streamline the development lifecycle for all engineering teams.
  • CI / CD Optimisation: Engineer and manage fast, reliable, CI native pipelines. Implement advanced, parallelised quality gates and automated feedback loops directly into the deployment infrastructure to eliminate manual intervention.
  • Architectural Testability: Analyse system architecture and cloud native topologies to suggest and implement improvements that enhance system testability and quality.
  • Production Quality: Build out monitoring, logging, and alerting tooling and standards. Translate incident postmortem findings into concrete, automated safeguards and process improvements.
  • Metrics and Diagnostics: Implement and track quality metrics to diagnose system bottlenecks, using data to drive targeted performance and reliability enhancements across our frameworks.
  • Mentoring and Engineering Maturity: Proactively drive forward the organisation-wide quality strategy, building and designing our testing ecosystem, and mentoring software engineers. Act as a thought leader to coach development teams on 'quality first' design.

Essential Experience

  • Strong, Recent Java Experience: Deep, hands-on proficiency in Java is required, this is non-negotiable. You should be able to speak confidently about JVM internals, design patterns, and idiomatic Java at a senior engineering level.
  • Software Engineering Background: You have worked as a software engineer or backend developer, with test automation architecture as part of (or the focus of) that engineering remit, not as a QA professional who picked up scripting.
  • Framework Design from Scratch: A proven track record of designing, building, and scaling multi-layered automation frameworks from the ground up (Integration, Contract, E2E, and Performance).
  • CI / CD and Pipeline Engineering: Heavy hands-on experience building, optimising, and maintaining CI / CD pipelines, with a focus on fast, parallelised execution and automated gates.
  • Cloud Native Architecture: Deep understanding of distributed system design, microservices, and cloud native environments, with the ability to optimise them for logging, observability, and testability.
  • Root Cause Debugging: Exceptional technical debugging skills across complex, distributed systems, with the ability to write robust automated regressions to address production vulnerabilities.
  • Technical Collaboration: Ability to define technical standards, document framework architectures clearly, and collaborate with engineering teams to ensure seamless adoption of quality tooling.

Nice to Have

  • Background as a general-purpose Software Engineer (backend-heavy) prior to specialising in test infrastructure.
  • Experience implementing, capturing, and visualising DORA metrics automatically within deployment pipelines.
  • Familiarity with feature flagging frameworks and progressive delivery infrastructure.
  • Experience in fintech, payments, or other high-throughput environments where transactional integrity, security, and strict reliability are paramount.

Why this role exists

Our business is growing rapidly. We recognise that to achieve fast delivery and systemic quality, we need to move away from traditional testing bottlenecks. We need dedicated engineers who can build the robust, scalable automation infrastructure required to support continuous, hands-off deployment. If you're a Java engineer who loves writing code that empowers other systems and teams to run faster and safer, we want to talk to you.

What we offer

We provide a supportive, high-growth environment where your impact is visible every day.

  • Financial: Competitive salary and life insurance.
  • Time Off: 33 days holiday (including public holidays) plus Birthday Leave.
  • Flexibility: Remote-first working culture that respects your other priorities.
  • Health: Family private healthcare and an Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Growth: A culture that champions career progression and direct investment in your learning and development.
  • Community:Regular team events and socials to keep our remote team connected.

Ready to bridge the gap? Apply to be a BR-DGE Builder today.

At BR-DGE, we champion diversity and inclusion. We believe that our roles should be open to everyone, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability, or neurotype. We value the unique talents and perspectives that each individual brings and try to create a fair and accessible hiring process for all.

jobs.description:
About PSD Citywide

Ready to make a real impact on communities across North America?

PSD Citywide isn’t just a software company; we’re transforming how Local, First Nations, and Regional Governments achieve success and build sustainable futures for their communities. As a recognized leader in Enterprise Asset Management, maintenance management, and planning solutions, we provide cutting-edge software and expert advisory services that improve infrastructure and public services.

Why join us? We are a "Fun-clusive" organization! This means we intentionally foster a supportive and engaging culture where your contributions are celebrated, your skills are rewarded, and your career growth is encouraged.

Ready to influence change? Bring your expertise in technology and data to our team and directly shape how local governments improve service delivery. Apply now!

Job Description

Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, and making a difference. As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a VP, Engineering to fill an existing vacancy and join our IT Department in a fully remote role (though occasional travel will be required) based in Canada. If you’re passionate about technology, problem-solving, and helping businesses maximize their potential, we want you to be a part of our team!

PSD Citywide is seeking a VP, Engineering to lead the delivery, performance, and continuous improvement of our integrated SaaS platform serving municipalities and public sector organizations across North America.

Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer (CTO), the VP, Engineering, will translate the Company's technology and product strategy into effective engineering execution. The role leads Software Engineering, Quality Assurance (QA) / Quality Engineering, and Systems Administration / Infrastructure, with day-to-day accountability for engineering operations, software delivery, technical standards, quality, infrastructure, talent, and continuous improvement.

The VP, Engineering will oversee the development, delivery, quality, reliability, and technical operation of PSD Citywide's cloud-based software solutions, including Enterprise Asset Management (EAM), Maintenance, GIS, Budgeting, and Permitting. The role will evolve the engineering operating model as the company scales, with particular focus on AI-enabled software development, quality engineering, automation, organizational effectiveness, and increasing the speed and reliability with which customer value is delivered.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salaries that recognize your skills and experience.
  • Wellness Coverage: Enjoy a comprehensive health and wellness benefits package that keeps you and your family secure and healthy.
  • Flexible Working: Work where you thrive! Enjoy remote work flexibility (specific regional options apply) while staying connected to our supportive team.
  • Work-Life Balance: Benefit from Flex Hours to manage your personal life and Paid Time Off (PTO) so you can fully recharge.
  • Unwind Early: Say hello to summer with our popular Summer Fridays—shorter work weeks to help you kick-start the weekend.
  • Culture & Community: Participate in fun social events (both virtual and in-person) and contribute to charity initiatives as part of our community focus.
  • Career Growth: Our Career Framework provides clear, structured paths for growth and ongoing learning, ensuring you reach your professional goals.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

  • Lead Software Engineering, QA / Quality Engineering, and Systems Administration / Infrastructure, building a high-performing, accountable, and collaborative organization.
  • Oversee the design, development, enhancement, maintenance, quality, reliability, and technical operation of PSD Citywide's cloud-based SaaS platform.
  • Partner with the CTO, Product Management, Business Analysis, and business leaders to prioritize engineering initiatives, translate product and business priorities into executable engineering plans, and maintain clear accountability between product ownership and engineering delivery.
  • Develop and lead the Company's AI-enabled engineering strategy, taking direct ownership of the evaluation, adoption, governance, and effective use of AI tools and practices throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Drive practical adoption of AI and automation across software development, QA / Quality Engineering, and technical operations where appropriate, including design, coding, code review, documentation, debugging, testing, release processes, systems administration, monitoring, and operational workflows.
  • Establish, monitor, and communicate meaningful engineering performance metrics, including delivery predictability, development cycle time, team capacity, release frequency, software quality and escaped defects, test automation, platform reliability, operational performance, budget effectiveness, and measurable outcomes from AI-enabled engineering practices.
  • Lead the modernization of software quality practices, including increased test automation, AI-assisted test development, improved regression testing, CI/CD practices, release quality controls, and greater engineering ownership of software quality.
  • Lead the engineering technology strategy and architectural direction of PSD Citywide's SaaS platform, ensuring architecture, technical debt, scalability, performance, maintainability, and modernization support long-term product and business objectives.
  • Establish clear ownership, accountability, and operating rhythms across Engineering teams and technical leaders, including delivery commitments, capacity planning, technical quality, risk identification, performance measurement, and timely escalation of issues affecting product commitments or customer outcomes.
  • Provide leadership and oversight for systems administration and infrastructure operations, including cloud environments, deployment infrastructure, platform reliability, monitoring, backup and recovery, operational resiliency, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with Product, Support, Advisory Services, Implementation, and other business functions to manage the upstream and downstream impacts of increased engineering capacity, automation, and delivery velocity and ensure engineering improvements translate into customer and business outcomes.
  • Develop and manage departmental budgets, financial plans, resource allocation, vendor relationships, contractor utilization, software licensing, and technology investments to ensure responsible financial stewardship and cost effectiveness.
  • Support business case development, effort estimation, and resource planning to ensure technology initiatives are appropriately scoped, prioritized, and budgeted.
  • Continuously evaluate and evolve the structure, skills, roles, leadership capacity, and operating model of the Engineering organization as the company scales and technology practices change; lead workforce planning, talent development, succession planning, recruitment, and performance management.
  • Ensure security, compliance, resiliency, and risk management are incorporated into engineering operations and software development practices, and establish appropriate AI governance covering customer data protection, source code confidentiality, intellectual property, vendor risk, responsible use, and cost management.
  • Other duties as required.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, technology operations, or software delivery leadership, including 5+ years leading engineering managers, technical leads, or multidisciplinary software development teams.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and scaling a multidisciplinary engineering organization of comparable size and complexity, including developing technical leaders, establishing effective management structures, and evolving processes as the organization grows.
  • Demonstrated experience successfully leading an engineering organization through the adoption of AI-enabled software development practices, with direct leadership involvement in strategy, implementation, adoption, and measurement of results.
  • Demonstrated ability to measure and communicate the impact of AI-enabled engineering practices, including improvements in developer productivity, development cycle time, product delivery velocity, software quality, testing efficiency, release frequency, or organizational capacity.
  • Strong working knowledge and practical experience with contemporary AI-assisted software engineering tools and techniques, including the ability to evaluate their capabilities, limitations, security implications, and appropriate use across development and quality engineering workflows.
  • Demonstrated experience leading or overseeing QA / Quality Engineering functions, including test automation, regression testing, release quality, and integration of quality practices throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Experience managing significant departmental budgets, financial planning, resource allocation, vendor relationships, contractor utilization, and technology investments.
  • Experience operating in a private-equity-backed or similarly metrics-driven environment, including supporting executive and Board-level reporting, performance reviews, and presentations.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS application development, cloud platforms, software architecture, APIs, and modern software delivery practices.
  • Experience leading the modernization and evolution of established SaaS platforms, including managing technical debt, architectural improvement, scalability, maintainability, and modernization alongside ongoing customer and product delivery commitments.
  • Demonstrated experience establishing and continuously improving modern software delivery practices, including iterative planning, capacity management, CI/CD, release management, engineering metrics, and appropriate use of Agile or Lean methodologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance technical priorities with business objectives, budget considerations, and customer requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and lead high-performing, accountable engineering organizations, including developing managers and technical leaders, coaching and performance management, succession planning, talent development, and attracting and retaining strong technical talent.
  • Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical issues, risks, investment decisions, and trade-offs into clear business terms for executive, Board, and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated experience successfully leading distributed or remote technical teams, including maintaining strong communication, accountability, collaboration, and team culture across locations.
  • Experience in GovTech, municipal technology, enterprise SaaS, asset management, ERP, or public sector software is considered an asset.

What Success Looks Like

  • A high-performing, accountable Engineering organization with strong technical and people leadership.
  • Improved delivery predictability, software quality, platform reliability, and release efficiency.
  • Material progress in test automation and modern QA / Quality Engineering practices.
  • Measurable, responsible adoption of AI that improves engineering productivity, product velocity, quality, and organizational capacity.
  • An engineering operating model, leadership structure, and skill base capable of supporting PSD Citywide's continued growth.

The Candidate Journey

Resume Review: Once you apply, an actual person will review your resume and we are committed to getting back to you with a response.

Phone Interview: PSD’s People and Culture team will connect with you to learn about your experience and discuss the role further. They’ll also give you an understanding of what the interview process involves, along with an estimated timeline.

Virtual Interview: Depending on the position, there will be one or two interviews with the Hiring Team that will include questions related to your skills, work experience, values and goals. We provide the opportunity to meet with a wide range of staff members so you can learn more about life at PSD Citywide.

Offer/Feedback: The Hiring Team will debrief and make a decision within a few days of your final interview. If successful, your Recruiter will present you with a verbal offer, followed by a formal offer letter via email. If the timing was not right for this particular opportunity, we will connect with you and provide feedback.

PSD Citywide is committed to ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. We believe in integration, and we are committed to meeting the needs of people with disabilities in a timely manner. We will do so by removing and preventing barriers to accessibility.

We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process. Should you require any accommodation, please indicate this when you apply, and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

PSD Citywide may use Google Gemini to assist with recruitment note taking during the hiring process. While we incorporate select AI features to enhance process efficiency, we remain committed to human-led decision making. All AI-generated outputs are subject to human review to ensure accuracy and fairness.
